description: fs.promises.watch as Node 22 has it on Linux: { eventType, filename } for changes the program makes after it starts; an AbortSignal ends it with an AbortError; 'buffer' filenames; break ends it; maxQueue with overflow 'error' throws ERR_FS_WATCH_QUEUE_OVERFLOW and with 'ignore' warns; recursive is Node's own watcher; ENOENT and the argument errors from the first next()
